name: St. Joseph County, IN
findings: St. Joseph County has 1,003 nonprofit organizations. 452 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 360 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, St. Joseph County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
41% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 10 social and fraternal organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 23 would.

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 66 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 66 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few housing organizations list membership
observations.text: 2 housing organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.
